service.description: Modbus TCP (modbus-tcp:// endpoint or driverEnumId DcdModbusTCP). DrtRead, DrtWrite and DrtCyclic polling on the register addresses in DeviceRequestItem.query; the bulk items share one read per address. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName; called by moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest. A request whose endpoint is another protocol is an error.
